Package org.apache.juneau.examples.mcp

Class ExampleServer

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.examples.mcp.ExampleServer
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class ExampleServer extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Boots ExampleMcpServer on an embedded Jetty server.

Run main to start the server on a fixed port (default 5000, or pass a port as the first argument) and leave it running so you can point ExampleClient (or any MCP client) at it. The in-process end-to-end test uses start(0) to boot on an OS-assigned ephemeral port instead.

The wiring mirrors Juneau's own test fixture: a Jetty Server plus the ExampleMcpServer servlet are placed in a BasicBeanStore, and JettyConfiguration (added via Microservice.Builder.configurations(Class...)) auto-mounts the @Rest servlet at "/" and drives the server lifecycle. Because the Server is supplied as a bean, we control the listen port directly — no jetty.xml required.
